lines.trans: One wise man once spoke important words.
You can sit for a long time on the quiet bank of a river.
And wait for your enemy to finally lose.
But sometimes you are sitting by the wrong river altogether.
Vitya, I remember that I still owe you a debt.
You are supposed to kick me two more times.
Well come on, kick me quickly, what are you waiting for?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level? We were ten percent ahead!

meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth. Core Russian part meaning 'after all, you know' in everyday speech.
